items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Herbie [Hancock] wanted him, when Herbie did Speak Like a Child. He wouldn’t do it.

ctx.x: As I heard it, he was driving a cab for a living.

He was driving a taxi. Yeah, that’s what he was doing. He said, “I don’t want to work.” He wouldn’t be a sideman. He had decided – this is what I mean by his obstinance. Herbie [Hancock] wanted him, when Herbie did Speak Like a Child. He wouldn’t do it. He said, “I don’t want to play anything but 4/4.” He’s very – what’s the word? – he wants it the way he wants it.
